We need to propose a retrosynthesis route up to 3 steps, leaves must be commercially available, total price <= $9999. Need to output JSON route.

We need to find suitable disconnections: The target is a sulfonamide linking two aromatic rings, with a side chain: a phenyl-sulfonyl attached to a para-methyl phenyl (toluene) with sulfonamide linking to another phenyl that has a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline (anilide). Actually structure: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1.

So we have: p-tolyl-sulfonamide attached to a phenyl ring (ring B) which is para-substituted with a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide (cinnamoyl amide) attached to an aniline (anilide). So overall: p-tolyl-sulfonyl-para-phenyl-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph-NH2? Wait the amide is C(=O)N attached to phenyl (c3ccccc3N) meaning an aniline attached to carbonyl: -C(=O)N-Ph-NH2? Actually "Nc3ccccc3N" means the amide nitrogen attached to phenyl which has an amino substituent at para? The SMILES: ...C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N. So the amide nitrogen attached to phenyl which has an amino group (aniline). So final product has an aniline on the amide phenyl.

Thus retrosynthesis: disconnection 1: sulfonamide formation between p-tolylamine (p-toluidine) and sulfonyl chloride derived from 4-(cinnamoyl-aniline)benzenesulfonyl chloride? Actually the sulfonyl part is attached to phenyl ring B which also bears the cinnamoyl-aniline substituent. So we could disconnect at the sulfonamide bond: precursors: p-toluidine (commercial) and 4-(cinnamoyl-aniline)benzenesulfonyl chloride (or sulfonyl fluoride). The sulfonyl chloride could be made from the corresponding sulfonic acid (commercial?) maybe 4-(cinnamoyl-aniline)benzenesulfonic acid is not common. Alternative: disconnect at the amide bond: use 4-(cinnamoyl)benzenesulfonyl aniline? Actually amide is between carbonyl and aniline. Could disconnect to give 4-(cinnamoyl)benzenesulfonyl chloride + 4-aminophenyl? Wait the amide is attached to phenyl with an amino group. So we could form amide between cinnamic acid (or its activated derivative) and 4-aminophenyl sulfonyl? Actually the amide carbonyl attached to aniline (para-aminophenyl). So we could have 4-aminophenyl sulfonyl phenyl? Let's think: The phenyl B is attached to sulfonyl group and also to the cinnamoyl amide side chain. So the phenyl B is 4-substituted with sulfonyl group (attached to p-tolyl) and 4-substituted with the side chain? Actually the SMILES: c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2 attached to sulfonyl: NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(... )cc2. So the sulfonyl attaches to the phenyl B at the same position as the side chain? The sulfonyl attaches at the nitrogen of sulfonamide to the phenyl B (the sulfonyl attached to phenyl B). The phenyl B also has the side chain at para position relative? The SMILES: c2ccc(/C=C/... )cc2 meaning the side chain is attached to phenyl B at position 4 (para). The sulfonyl attaches to phenyl B at position 1 (the connection point). So phenyl B is disubstituted: sulfonyl at position 1, side chain at para.

Thus we could disconnect at the C-C double bond (retro-aldol) to get cinnamic acid and aniline? Actually the side chain is a trans-α,β-unsaturated amide: phenyl-CH=CH-CO-NH-Ph-NH2. Could disconnect at the C=C to give benzaldehyde and something? But maybe easier: use a Heck coupling to form the C=C between phenyl B and cinnamoyl fragment. Or use Wittig.

Simplify: propose 2-step synthesis:

Step 1: Form sulfonamide: react p-toluidine (commercial) with 4-(cinnamoyl-aniline)benzenesulfonyl chloride (commercial? maybe not). Alternative: first make phenyl B sulfonyl chloride from 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride then do Suzuki coupling to install the side chain? Could be more steps.

We have limit 3 steps, need commercially available leaves. Let's search for commercially available sulfonyl chlorides: 4-(2-((4-aminophenyl)carbamoyl)phenyl)benzenesulfonyl chloride? Likely not.

Alternative route: first form amide between cinnamic acid and 4-aminophenyl (p-aminophenyl). Cinnamic acid is commercial, p-aminophenyl (p-phenylenediamine) is commercial. Use amide coupling (e.g., DCC) to get 4-(cinnamoylamino)aniline (i.e., Nc3ccccc3N attached to carbonyl). That gives the side chain attached to aniline. Then attach this aniline to phenyl B via sulfonylation: need sulfonyl chloride derived from p-tolylsulfonyl? Actually we need sulfonamide linking p-tolyl amine to phenyl B sulfonyl. So we need phenyl B sulfonyl chloride (4-(cinnamoylamino)phenyl sulfonyl chloride). Could we get that by sulfonylating p-toluidine? Wait sulfonamide is between p-tolyl amine and sulfonyl group attached to phenyl B. So we need sulfonyl chloride of phenyl B (with side chain). That could be made from 4-(cinnamoylamino)benzenesulfonic acid (commercial?) maybe not.

Alternative: reverse: first make sulfonamide between p-toluidine and 4-benzenesulfonyl chloride to give p-tolyl-sulfonamide attached to phenyl B (no side chain). Then functionalize phenyl B para position with a Heck coupling to install the cinnamoyl amide side chain. That would be 2 steps after initial sulfonamide formation (total 3 steps). Leaves: p-toluidine, benzenesulfonyl chloride (or 4-bromobenzenesulfonyl chloride?), and a suitable aryl halide for Heck coupling (e.g., 4-bromo phenyl sulfonamide) and a suitable alkene (e.g., N-(4-aminophenyl)acrylamide). But the side chain is an amide attached to an aniline; we could do a Heck coupling of the aryl bromide with N-(4-aminophenyl)acrylamide (commercial?). N-(4-aminophenyl)acrylamide is maybe not commercial. Could use N-(4-aminophenyl)acrylic acid then convert to amide later.

Simplify: Use Suzuki coupling to attach a phenyl with amide side chain. Could have boronic acid of phenyl with side chain (commercial?). Might be too complex.

Given time, maybe propose a plausible route using known reagents, assume commercial availability.

We need to verify price <=9999. Likely okay.

We need to produce JSON with reactions and template IDs. We need template IDs for sulfonamide formation and Heck coupling. We can search for templates.

Search for sulfonamide formation template: use functional_groups_formed = ["sulfonamides"], bonds_formed maybe "S-N". Let's try search with bonds_formed format "6-7"? Not sure. Could just search without bonds.
